<!-- pr-reviewer: e0e4fee6813d145189f87ca2b8eb62882a2064d9 -->
Needs changes before merge: two findings. All local checks passed.

I read the whole PR diff and issue #2756. I checked the rules on upstream main `3b4c4b2cb8d48d9442466b23e49f1962d38b4f6d`.
The local trial merge is `c3906cc045f9216f2e474b76ac66459fbae838b1`. Its first parent is the PR head above.

The tests cover unknown keys, axis removal, saved-file read-back, and the split between work and tool axes.
This is a safety-tier review: the edited values feed clearance checks and post kinematics.

**Requested before merge**

1. **Class: repeated frame computation.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/machine_axis_chain.rs:96` builds the axis rows on each frame. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/machine_file_editor.rs:256` builds them again for the refusal keys. The row draw also builds the notes again. These calls walk the JSON tree and build derived lists when the input has not changed. This breaks the current `crates/ui/AGENTS.md` Frame cost rule. Cache the rows, row keys and notes with their input owner. Invalidate the cache when the draft changes. Add a counter test for unchanged frames and a test for changed input. Add the required `frame_cost::span` for the new frame work. Apply this rule to the whole new axis group, not only one call.
2. **Class: missing UI evidence.** The UI change at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/machine_file_editor.rs:262` needs before/after screenshots in the PR body. The body links one screenshot of the new editor. I checked the image; it has no before view. Add a screenshot of the same pane before this change. Label the two views. Keep the images on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body.

**Local results**

All commands ran locally, in the foreground, on the trial merge. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 124 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled; 11.1 minutes.
- App `machine`: 57 passed, 0 failed. This includes the 24 new app tests.
- UI library, from `crates/ui`: 1,615 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored. This includes the seven new UI tests.
- `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`: six steps, all 11 light tests passed, 0 failed, 0 stalled; 19.5 minutes.
- `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

**Extra suites run**

The quick gate ran these suites by name:

- `example_catalog`: 41 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed, 0 failed.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed, 0 failed.
- `first_part_programs`: passed.

The PR changes no import code or test-data directory. The extra importer and fixture suites do not apply.

**Mutation checks**

The body gives no mutation record. I ran two independent probes on scratch copies in `/tmp`. The review worktree stayed unchanged.
The scratch project used an exact copy of `chain.rs` and its two helper functions.

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| Store `1` instead of `-1` for a reversed linear axis | `reverse_roundtrip` failed: actual `Some(Number(1))`, expected `Some(Number(-1))` |
| Disable the work/tool guard in `move_axis` | `refuse_work_tool_swap` failed: `a table rotary must not trade places with a head rotary` |

Both tests passed before the mutations. Both passed after the exact source was restored.

Goldens moved: none. The PR changes no recorded NC program or catalog file.
No full heavy lane was run, as the current upstream review rules require for this P6 issue.
No end-to-end program was posted from a machine file saved by this editor.

The PR is mergeable. I left its draft state, labels and title unchanged, as instructed for this review.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
